payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and protocols for evaluating segmentation quality, including comparisons with human segmentation and the use of reference corpora.

claims.text: Segmentation quality is evaluated through automatic comparisons with a manually annotated reference corpus, such as the Annodis corpus.
An evaluation protocol was established to measure the performance of segmenters, focusing on metrics like F-score and recall.
The evaluation includes measuring the distance between human segmentations and those produced by automatic systems.
